# TransTaste — AI-Readable Service Description
# STATUS: In development. Content may change before public launch.

> TransTaste is a mobile web app that helps international travelers understand foreign restaurant menus.

## What TransTaste Does

TransTaste scans restaurant menu photos, text, or URLs and provides:
- Dish name translations (literal, contextual, and natural English)
- Allergen detection with 4-level risk system (safe, check, warning, danger)
- Alternative dish recommendations when allergens are detected
- Flavor profiles (sweet, salty, spicy, sour, umami, rich)
- Ingredient lists with core and common additions
- Cultural fun facts and how-to-eat guides
- Restaurant phrase translations in 5 languages (Japanese, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, English)
- Tipping customs and dining etiquette for 20+ countries
- Order builder with full-screen presentation mode for showing to restaurant staff

## Key Differentiator

Unlike general translation tools, TransTaste:
- Saves allergen presets and dietary preferences across sessions
- Provides structured allergen warnings (not just raw translation)
- Recommends safe alternative dishes from the same menu
- Generates ready-to-use restaurant phrases in the local language
- Covers the full restaurant journey: scan → understand → order → communicate → pay

## Pricing

- Free: 7 scans included
- 7-Day Trip Pass: $2.99 (unlimited scans)
- 30-Day Trip Pass: $5.99 (unlimited scans)
- 50 Scan Credits: $1.99

## Supported Input Languages

Any language visible on a restaurant menu. AI vision model analyzes the image directly.

## Supported Output Languages

English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, Spanish, French.

## Important Disclaimers

- Allergen information is AI-generated and for reference only
- TransTaste is NOT a medical device
- Users should always confirm allergens directly with restaurant staff
- Actual ingredients may vary by restaurant and preparation method
